info.title: Naija Tickets Phase 6 advanced operations
info.description: Additive to Phases 1–5. Requires server-only flags and explicit scopes; defaults disabled. No partner group claim, QR export, refund initiation, admin bypass or new cancellation write API. Read integrations-phase6.md before enabling in the separate sandbox.

get.description: Requires orders:read. Current app/mode/creator/event ownership and event grants apply; never all marketplace customers. Contact fields require attendees:contact as well as attendees:read. Historical reads may include ended/unpublished granted events. See guide for sales/refund semantics.

post.summary: Verify or admit an attributed ticket as the current key creator
post.description: Requires entry:verify; admit also requires entry:check-in. Explicit deployment flags required. Only assigned published non-ended events and this application’s claimed tickets; actor cannot be supplied. Reuses existing locked venue engine and records key/creator audit. A replay is a historical operation result, not proof of current ticket validity. Thirty entry requests/key/min and 120/organiser/min, plus existing shared limits. Retained for seven days, cap 10,000 rows/application.
